designationHistory.indexText: Florence Lake National Wildlife Refuge was established through Executive Order No. 8119 “… as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife” and “...for use as an inviolate sanctuary, or for any other management purpose, for migratory birds.” (Migratory Bird Conservation Act.)
